# Status Reports

Periodic **delta** reports. Each one covers the period since the previous
report — a narrative synthesis of what shipped, not a daily log and not tied
to session boundaries. Cadence is operator-driven (weekly, twice-weekly,
daily — whatever fits).

**At the start of a session, read the most recent report** to see where things
left off. Reports are the human narrative layered on top of the commit history:
the git log is the atomic, per-change ground truth; a status report synthesizes
it into themes, outcomes, and decisions.

Files are named `YYYY-MM-DD.md`, where the date is the report's as-of date.
The full "write a status report" workflow — trigger phrases and the sections
each report carries — lives in `{{TASKS_REL}}/docs/USING.md` (**Status reports**).
